title: Keep coins within bounds
description: Clamp brings writes into the allowed range. Integer fields also round fractional writes.
actions:
print("Starting coins:", data.Coins.Get())
data.Coins.Set(175)
print("After Set(175):", data.Coins.Get())
data.Coins.Set(5.8)
print("After Set(5.8):", data.Coins.Get())
data.Coins.Increment(10)
print("After Increment(10):", data.Coins.Get())
expected: The output should show 20, 100, 6, then 16. The final Coins value is 16.

title: Reject an invalid write
description: Reject raises an error instead of changing a value that falls outside the declared bounds.
actions:
local ok, reason = pcall(function()
    data.Coins.Set(175)
end)
print("Write accepted:", ok)
if not ok then
    print(reason)
end
print("Coins are still:", data.Coins.Get())
expected: The write is refused, the error explains the bounds, and Coins remains 20.

title: Try the wrong value type
description: A numeric field refuses a string even when the bounds policy is Clamp.
actions:
data.Coins.Set("lots")
print("This line is not reached.")
expected: The run reports an invalid write. Coins remains 20.

title: Cap an inventory and evict the oldest
description: ArrayOf gives every element a schema. MaxItems with Evict = "Front" drops the oldest entry once the array is full.
actions:
data.Inventory.Insert({ Id = "sword", Amount = 1 })
data.Inventory.Insert({ Id = "shield" })
data.Inventory.Insert({ Id = "bow", Amount = 2 })
data.Inventory.Insert({ Id = "potion", Amount = 500 })
print("Items:", data.Inventory.Count())
print("First item:", data.Inventory[1].Id.Get())
print("Potion count clamped to:", data.Inventory[3].Amount.Get())
print("Has a bow?", data.Inventory.Has({ Id = "bow", Amount = 2 }))
expected: Three items remain, the sword was evicted, the omitted Amount defaulted to 1, and 500 potions clamped to 99.

title: Track unique unlocks
description: SetOf keeps membership, not order. Adding a member twice changes nothing.
actions:
print("Added:", data.Unlocked.Add("AshfallRidge"))
print("Added again:", data.Unlocked.Add("AshfallRidge"))
data.Unlocked.Add("DeepMines")
print("Unlocked:", data.Unlocked.Count())
print("Has DeepMines?", data.Unlocked.Has("DeepMines"))
print("Removed:", data.Unlocked.Remove("AshfallRidge"))
print("Unlocked now:", data.Unlocked.Count())
expected: The first Add returns true and the repeat returns false. Two areas are unlocked, then one after the Remove.

title: Compute a level from XP
description: Derived fields are computed from other fields, recompute whenever an input changes, and refuse writes.
actions:
data.Level.Observe(function(level)
    print("Level is now", level)
end)
data.Xp.Increment(250)
local ok, reason = pcall(function()
    data.Level.Set(9)
end)
print("Direct write accepted:", ok)
expected: Observe reports level 1 immediately and level 3 after the XP change. The direct write is refused.

title: Enumerate teams and perks
description: Enum accepts one declared member. Flags is a set of declared switches you enable and disable by name.
actions:
data.Team.Set("Blue")
print("Team:", data.Team.Get())
local ok, reason = pcall(function()
    data.Team.Set("Green")
end)
print("Green accepted:", ok)
data.Perks.Enable("Fast")
data.Perks.Enable("Lucky")
data.Perks.Disable("Fast")
print("Enabled perks:", table.concat(data.Perks.Get(), ", "))
expected: Team becomes Blue, Green is refused, and only Lucky remains enabled.

title: Name pets in a dictionary
description: DictOf keys exist once something writes them. Optional fields have no default and read as nil until set.
actions:
print("Pets before:", data.Pets.Count())
data.Pets.Ember.Species.Set("Fox")
print("Nickname before:", data.Pets.Ember.Nickname.Get())
data.Pets.Ember.Nickname.Set("Em")
print("Nickname after:", data.Pets.Ember.Nickname.Get())
data.Pets.Ash.Species.Set("Wolf")
print("Pets after:", data.Pets.Count())
expected: No pets exist until a write. The nickname reads nil, then Em. Two pets exist at the end.

title: Key a map by user id
description: MapOf declares the key type, so integer keys stay integers instead of becoming strings.
actions:
data.Friends[42].Name.Set("Ava")
data.Friends[7].Name.Set("Kai")
print("Friends:", data.Friends.Count())
print("Friend 42:", data.Friends[42].Name.Get())
local ok, reason = pcall(function()
    data.Friends[1.5].Name.Set("Half")
end)
print("Fractional key accepted:", ok)
expected: Two friends are stored under numeric keys and the fractional key is refused.

title: Count past the number limit
description: Big fields hold currencies that outgrow a double. Scribe.Short renders any number the way a player reads it.
actions:
data.Bank.Increment("5e20")
print("Bank:", tostring(data.Bank.Get()))
print("Bank, short:", data.Bank.Get():Short())
print("Coins, short:", Scribe.Short(data.Coins.Get(), 1))
expected: The bank reads 1.5e21, renders as 1.50Sx, and the coins render as 1.5K.

title: Separate saved data from session state
description: Session fields reset on rejoin, ServerOnly fields never reach a client, and Shared fields replicate to everyone. All three read the same way on the server.
actions:
data.Title.Set("Champion")
data.Secret.Set("server-only note")
data.Session.InCombat.Set(true)
print("Title:", data.Title.Get())
print("In combat:", data.Session.InCombat.Get())
expected: Every field reads normally on the server. The Fields panel shows which ones persist and who receives them.

title: React to a change
description: Changed fires after a write with the new and old values. Update reads, transforms, and writes in one step.
actions:
local disconnect = data.Coins.Changed(function(new, old)
    print("Coins changed from", old, "to", new)
end)
data.Coins.Update(function(current)
    return current * 3
end)
disconnect()
data.Coins.Increment(1)
data.Settings.Music.Toggle()
print("Music on?", data.Settings.Music.Get())
expected: One change message appears for the Update. The Increment after disconnect is silent, and Music is off.
